name: Phrasal verbs e combinações
summaryPt: Combinações verbo + preposição mudam o sentido do verbo.

meaningUses.en: look = olhar, look for = procurar, look after = cuidar
meaningUses.enPt: look = olhar, look for = procurar, look after = cuidar

meaningUses.en: get up, wake up, turn on, turn off

meaningUses.pt: Algumas são separáveis (put on / put the shoes on)
meaningUses.en: Put on your shoes. / Put your shoes on.
meaningUses.enPt: Calce seus sapatos. / Calce seus sapatos.

formation.pt: A combinação funciona como um verbo só.
formation.pattern: look for, get up, turn on

formation.pt: O objeto pode ir entre o verbo e a partícula.
formation.pattern: turn on the light / turn the light on

examples.en: I turn on the light. / I turn the light on.

subjectAgreement.example: She looks for her keys. He gets up at 6.

pronunciation.pt: Em combinações com up/on/off, a partícula costuma ser fraca, mas em phrasal verbs destacada.

contrast.pt: O verbo + preposição segue as regras normais do tempo verbal.
contrast.en: I get up at 6. (present simple) — I got up at 6. (past)

examples.en: I look for my keys every morning.
She looks after her little brother.
I'm looking forward to the weekend.
examples.pt: Estou ansioso pelo fim de semana.

guidedPractice.full: She looks after her little brother.
I'm looking forward to the weekend.
guidedPractice.pt: Estou ansioso pelo fim de semana.
guidedPractice.explanation: look forward to = aguardar com expectativa.

guidedPractice.prompt: I ___ off the TV before bed.
guidedPractice.full: I turn off the TV before bed.
guidedPractice.pt: Desligo a TV antes de dormir.

guidedPractice.prompt: I can't find my keys. I need to ___ for them.
guidedPractice.full: I need to look for my keys.
guidedPractice.explanation: need to + look for = precisar procurar.

guidedPractice.full: She takes care of her mom.

reviewQuiz.full: She looks after her little brother.
I'm looking forward to the weekend.
reviewQuiz.pt: Estou ansioso pelo fim de semana.

reviewQuiz.prompt: I ___ off the TV before bed. (turn)
reviewQuiz.full: I turn off the TV before bed.
reviewQuiz.pt: Desligo a TV antes de dormir.

reviewQuiz.full: She takes care of her mom.
reviewQuiz.explanation: take care of (fixo); com she → takes.

reviewQuiz.full: I woke up late this morning.
reviewQuiz.explanation: wake up = acordar (wake → woke no passado).
